# AI Marking (aimarking.ai)
An AI-powered tool specifically designed for marking GCSE Mathematics past papers.

## Key Features
- Supports Edexcel, AQA, and OCR GCSE Maths.
- Handwriting recognition: Marks scanned or photographed student work.
- Instant Feedback: Provides step-by-step guidance on where marks were lost.
- Accuracy: Matches human examiner marking logic with 98% similarity.

## Target Audience
- GCSE Students (Year 10/11)
- Private Maths Tutors
- Secondary School Teachers
